# SYS-003: Running kernel is the newest installed

- **Group:** System
- **Severity when it fails:** moderate
- **Root:** not needed

## Why it matters

A kernel update is installed to /boot but only runs after a reboot. A running kernel older than the newest installed one means kernel security fixes are on disk and not in effect.

## Verify by hand

```sh
uname -r; ls /boot/vmlinuz-*
```

## How to fix it

Reboot to load the patched kernel.

## What a fix can break

A reboot interrupts every service on the host.

Run `stackward explain SYS-003` for the same text in your terminal. [All checks](index.md).
